actions.action: Cut off all damaged or rotting leaves
Unpot the plant and check the roots for mold or rot
Rinse the roots thoroughly with water
Mix 1 tsp lemon juice into 500 ml water
Soak the roots and stem in the lemon solution for 20 minutes
Prepare a 50/50 mix of coconut husk chips and sand or organic soil, checking it by squeezing
Repot into a new pot, spreading the roots and tapping the pot to settle the medium
Place in a cool, airy spot for one day without watering
Dilute 100 ml coconut water in 300 ml water and pour onto the roots and medium
Move the plant to a spot with gentle sunlight
Mix 2 tsp rice in 500 ml water and spray onto shoots and medium twice a month

verdict.reason: The answer treats root rot rather than sunburn and thirst, and its advice to strip all the leaves, bare-root the plant and withhold water would harm a dehydrated, sun-stressed peace lily and delay the simple fix of watering it and moving it into indirect light.
